failure_modes.cause: Vapour pressure of methanol exceeds pump inlet pressure at T > 60°C
failure_modes.mitigation: Pressurise feed reservoir to 0.5 bar above vapour pressure

failure_modes.cause: Particulate matter or catalyst fines accumulation
failure_modes.mitigation: Install inline filter before BPR valve

failure_modes.cause: Flow rate too low to achieve enhanced laminar mixing
failure_modes.mitigation: Increase flow rate or adjust reactor geometry to enhance mixing

single_points_of_failure: BPR valve — blockage stops all flow
validation_experiments: Run blank methanol at Q=0.24158 mL/min for 60 min; monitor pressure for drift > 5%
Test BPR valve with particulate-laden solvent to assess blockage risk
Conduct residence time distribution (RTD) study to verify mixing efficiency at operational flow rate
